d: This is an archive of Mimi Yanagi (@MimiYanagi) on Baraag. These are works commissioned by her. She has allegedly been arrested by UK police and charged for lolicon works. It's unclear if any of these are the culprit but it seems likely. She has been radio silent for a couple months but her Baraag account is still up. I am uploading this here to make sure that these works are not censored and lost. The answer to censorship is always spreading it around more.
